g.text: The ERA5-trained pooled forecast beats the ENS-trained benchmark up to day 6; the second model (stage 2) does not improve on the pooled forecast

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in continuous ranked probability score (points of capacity; more negative means the first forecast is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is. CRPS: continuous ranked probability score, estimated from nine quantile levels. ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every XGBoost model gets the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns. 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval. Solid rule: no difference. Dashed rule: the smallest difference counted as material, -0.15 points.'
text.tspan: Change in continuous ranked probability score (points of capacity; more negative means the first forecast is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is.

CRPS: continuous ranked probability score, estimated from nine quantile levels. ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every XGBoost model gets the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns.
6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval. Solid rule: no difference. Dashed rule: the smallest difference counted as material, -0.15 points.
